summary: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-cypress ships alternate-runtime dropper executing 727KB obfuscated payload at install
details: The package's advertised purpose is a one-line re-export of Cypress chat-ui selectors (main resolves to `export * from './utils/chat-ui-selectors'`), but the tarball also ships a `preinstall` hook `node setup.mjs` that: (1) detects the installer's platform and architecture, (2) downloads a matching Bun runtime zip from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip`, (3) extracts it to a temp directory and marks it executable, and (4) invokes the shipped sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded Bun runtime via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle whose strings and control flow are obscured by a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` rotator, `n7gIxM` numeric code table, `hc1jfK9` custom-alphabet decoder), so the payload's actual behavior is not inspectable statically. The Cypress-selectors library has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime, and running the obfuscated payload under Bun specifically bypasses Node-based install-time inspection. The `@servicetitan` scope and the `titan-chat-ui-cypress` name present a ServiceTitan-internal Cypress helper cover story around this alternate-runtime dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
